<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 31:18">Targ. Job XXXI, 18</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 50b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>נפל כ׳ בבירא</he> the stomach fell into the well, i.e. your definition of the ‘inner stomach’ is of no value.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70:8">Gen. R. s. 70</cite> (prov.) <he>כ׳ טענא רגליא</he> the stomach carries the feet, i.e. cheerful prospects lend physical energy; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 123:2">Yalk. ib. 123</cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 12a:7">Gitt. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>דנהום כַּרְסֵיה לא שוי</he> (Ar. <he>דנהם כריסא</he>) who is not worth the bread he eats; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 97a">B. Kam. 97ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9:1">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite> <he>כְּרֵיסֵיה דהאי גברא קומך בזעה</he> this man’s (my) stomach is before thee, cut it open (I cannot pay for my meal); Pesik. Shub., p. 164ᵇ <he>הא כ׳ … בזעיה</he> (masc.); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 65b:18">Yeb. 65ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>איכו ילדת לי חדא כ׳ אחריתי</he> Oh that you would bear unto me one more issue of the womb!—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> <he>מני … בכ׳ דביתך</he> (= h. <he>בקרב ביתך</he>) count twenty beams in the inner chamber of thy house; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:6:7">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>גו בייתיך</he>).—Pl. <he>כְּרֵי סַיָּא</he> (m.); <cite ref="K01169"><he>כְּרֵיסַן</he></cite>, <cite ref="K01256"><he>כַּרְסָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 5:22">Targ. Y. Num. V, 22</cite> (not <he>כְּרִיסָן</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 17:14">Targ. Ps. XVII, 14</cite>.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 103a:6">Keth. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>תרתי כ׳ לית לה</he> she has not two stomachs (double alimentation is of no use to her).
